title: Who is Cartethyia? Wuthering Waves
sources: https://wutheringwaves.kurogames.com official news 2755 'Profile Reveal | Feathered Tempest — Cartethyia': the wandering knight who travels across Rinascita; formerly the Blessed Maiden, the vessel of Divinity, and the Queen of Gale and Tide, she went by the name Fleurdelys; now a free and unfettered wandering knight. Attribute Aero, Weapon Sword, 5 stars

Official news 2748 'Post-Lament Anthropocene: Stars Intertwined | Cartethyia' lore images: Cartethyia's Story ('I was born from the Threnodian's curse and malice. It made me wear the crown, bathe in the glory of the Blessed Maiden'); Overclock Diagnostic Report (a Second Awakening lets her transition freely between two forms; 'When Miss Cartethyia... No, wait, Fleurdelys, demonstrated her powers, the storm nearly tore the entire simulation apart!'); A Different Form (transforms into Fleurdelys upon using her Resonance Ability; as Fleurdelys she's the Queen of Gale and Tide); Cartethyia's Worry (when transforming into Fleurdelys she has to keep reminding herself: manners, tone, everything composed and solemn, 'it's actually really hard'); Worn Wooden Sword (a gift from a retired dramatist; as a child she patrolled the village, brandishing it at every 'injustice')
Official news 2364 'Post-Lament Anthropocene: Enemies — Fleurdelys': 'The fabricated Maiden, a vessel forged by divine hands. Her birth was but a carefully orchestrated plot.'
Art: official Kuro Games images, cropped only (see presskit/SOURCE.txt), credited on screen

scenes.narration: She was once worshipped as the Blessed Maiden. Now she's just a wandering knight. This is Cartethyia, in Wuthering Waves.
Her old titles: vessel of Divinity, and Queen of Gale and Tide. Back then, she went by the name Fleurdelys.
But that life began with a curse. She was born from the Threnodian's malice, and her birth was part of a carefully orchestrated plot.
Today, she can switch freely between two forms. When she becomes Fleurdelys, her storm once nearly tore a test simulation apart.
The hard part? Staying solemn as Fleurdelys. She has to keep reminding herself to mind her manners and her tone.
As a child, she patrolled her village with a wooden sword, swinging it at every injustice. Now she's a five-star Aero sword user.
So, Cartethyia or Fleurdelys: which form do you like more? Tell me in the comments.
